## Import

```ts
import { RBottomAppBar } from "@ripple-design/rui"
```

## Props

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fabAlignmentMode` | `RBottomAppBarFabAlignmentMode` | no | Controls whether the docked FAB is centered or aligned to the logical end. |
| `fabAnimationMode` | `RBottomAppBarFabAnimationMode` | no | Chooses scale or horizontal-slide motion when the FAB alignment changes. |
| `fabAttached` | `boolean` | no | Controls whether the docked FAB is cradled by the Bottom App Bar. |
| `fabCradleMargin` | `string` | no | Sets the space between the standard FAB and its cradle. |
| `fabCradleRoundedCornerRadius` | `string` | no | Sets the radius of the rounded cradle shoulders. |
| `fabCradleVerticalOffset` | `string` | no | Sets the distance between the FAB center and the bar top edge. |
| `hideOnScroll` | `boolean` | no | Hides the parent Scaffold bottom bar while scrolling down. |
| `color` | `RSurfaceColor` | no | Controls the Bottom App Bar surface color. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | no | Labels the toolbar when no visible label is available. |
| `ariaLabelledby` | `string` | no | References an element that labels the toolbar. |

Generated from `packages/rui/src/components/bottomAppBar/types.ts`.
